title: Characteristic ideal equals the voltage Laplacian determinant for connected leafless Zp-to-the-l graph covers with l at least two
author: Kleine, Sören; Müller, Katharina
work: On the growth of the Jacobians in $\mathbb{Z}_p^l$-voltage covers of graphs
difficulty_reason: The author constructs the Jacobian Iwasawa module from an inverse limit of finite covering divisor sequences, identifies the voltage Laplacian presentation, and compares it with the augmentation module through a rank-one pseudo-null cokernel. The completed-module and inverse-limit identifications are substantive core; rank at least two is essential and the rank-one correction is excluded.
